personal.name: Pujan Parikh
personal.subtitle: Software Engineer ✦ 8+ Years
personal.summary: Software Engineering professional with 8+ years of experience leading, building and testing large enterprise AI driven applications.
highlights: Led end-to-end delivery of complex features, maintaining a consistent track record of accurate scoping and on-time releases.

Engineered an autonomous, AI-driven development pipeline utilizing Model Context Protocols (MCPs) to seamlessly extract Jira/Confluence requirements, scaffold code, generate Selenium tests, and conduct SCM DevOps reviews.
Strong expertise with building web and native systems using GraphQL, RESTful Web APIs and Reactive Approach.
Proficient with Data Structures and Object-Oriented Programming in JavaScript, Java and Python.

sections.heading: Product
bullets: Architected and scaled core features for two OCI PaaS products: Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) and Process Automation (OPA).
Partnered cross-functionally with Design and Product teams to define technical roadmaps, project estimates, and release criteria.
Engineered HITL use-case, allowing AI agents to pause execution and trigger approval workflows for safe edge-case resolution.
Collaborated with Data Science to fine-tune AI models, optimizing generational accuracy across core product features.

Built an event-driven abstraction layer to decouple a highly complex, monolithic drag-and-drop UI component (Structured Process Builder), transforming it into a reusable micro-frontend adopted by 2 other products.
Built custom React hooks to abstract complex business logic and optimize front-end rendering performance.
Developed GraphQL queries and REST with OpenAPI spec for core business logic to power complex front-end workflows.
Owned the development of the OPA Decision Adapter, enabling seamless platform integration across the Oracle cloud (OCI).
Technologies used: JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, Java, Kotlin, Spring Boot, React.js, Kafka, Kubernetes, GraphQL.

sections.heading: Infrastructure
bullets: Led the migration of testing infrastructure to Playwright, driving developer adoption and eliminating frequent release regressions.
Headed an error management initiative for support to independently resolve on-call issues, reducing engineering escalations.
Engineered distributed state management infra for host shell and 14 micro-frontend plugins utilizing Redux reducer injection.
Collaborated on the global release process, utilizing Shepard for stable and consistent product rollouts across 18 OCI regions.
Mentored API teams in front-end development concepts and best practices and documented processes for future reference.

Technologies: Angular, TypeScript, Java, RxJS, Lodash, Sass, Cypress, Linux, Shell, VDL.
